examples.arabic: ابتسم الرجل وقدم لي وصفا دقيقا للطريق وكأن العلم نور
examples.english: The man smiled and gave me precise directions, as if knowledge was light.
examples.transliteration: Ibtasama ar-rajulu wa qaddama li wasfan daqeeqan lit-tareeqi wa ka'anna al-'ilma noorun.

examples.arabic: وعليكم السلام صباح النور يا أحمد كيف حالكَ
examples.english: And peace be upon you too morning of light Ahmad how are you
examples.transliteration: Wa alaykum as-salam sabah an-nur ya Ahmad kayfa haluka

examples.arabic: ردت الدكتورة ليلى تحيته: "صباح النور يا أستاذ حسن، نعم، أنا في طريقي إليه الآن،" رامقة ساعتها اليدوية، تلميحاً خفياً.
examples.english: Dr. Layla returned his greeting: "Good morning (of light), Professor Hassan, yes, I am on my way to it now," glancing at her wristwatch, a subtle hint.
examples.transliteration: Raddat ad-duktūrah Layla taḥīyatahu: "Ṣabāḥ an-nūr yā ustādh Ḥasan, na'am, anā fī ṭarīqī ilayhi al-ān," rāmiqatun sā'atahā al-yadawīyah, talmīḥan khafīyan.
examples.storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum
